calls.statement: SELECT join_date, count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-10' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'stg' AS src, join_date, count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member) THEN member_id END) AS in_dim FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10' GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_all', NULL, count(*), count(DISTINCT member_id), NULL FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_max', max(sale_date), count(*), NULL, NULL FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-10-01'
ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT sale_date, count(*) AS lines, max(etl_loaded_at) AS loaded FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH m AS (SELECT member_id, min(join_date) AS first_join, max(join_date) AS last_join, count(*) AS versions FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_join = DATE '2026-10-03') AS first_join_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_join = DATE '2026-10-03') AS last_join_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_join <> last_join) AS inconsistent, max(versions) AS maxv, count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_join = DATE '2026-10-03' AND versions > 1) AS multi FROM m
